description: This file defines and exports functions for fetching project cost data and cost history sums from a backend API. It interacts with an API client and retrieves data related to projects, including current costs and historical cost deltas.

methods.name: getProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated cost for a specific project by projectId, calling the GET /api/projects/:projectId/cost endpoint and returning projectId, cost, and currency.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the total cost of a project, considering cost history deltas, by projectId, calling the GET /api/projects/:projectId/cost-history-sum endpoint and returning projectId and total cost.
